Aiworks 是專注於企業 AI 應用的顧問機構。我們致力於協助企業解決三大核心問題：AI 該用在哪裡、如何有效導入，以及如何在組織中穩定運作。
我們提供的是協助團隊建立「人機協作」的新一代工作模式，讓 AI 真正進入實務工作，協助企業減少重複性任務並提升決策效率。自 2016 年成立以來，我們已成功培訓超過 20,000 名學員，並與逾 200 家跨產業企業深度合作。同時作為OpenAI Advanced Partner，以此為基石，協助企業在 AI 浪潮中精準落地。
作為 FDE，你是 Aiworks 技術實踐的先鋒。你的目標是直接解決客戶端的技術落地問題。你將與顧問團隊協作，以 OpenAI 的強大生態為核心，並根據業務需求靈活整合最合適的 AI 技術架構。這個職位適合熱愛技術挑戰、追求系統穩定性，並享受「用技術直接轉化為商業價值」的工程師。
【工作內容】
作為 FDE，您將站在企業 AI 轉型的第一線，將顧問規劃與客戶需求轉化為可穩定運行的 AI 系統，推動方案從 PoC 走向正式落地。
應用場景及需求釐清深入合作企業的業務流程，協助釐清 AI 應用的切入點，並將複雜的作業轉化為 AI 專案落地需求。多模型解決方案部署以 OpenAI 服務為核心，並視需求整合其他先進模型或開源技術，為客戶實作如 RAG 知識庫、AI Agent 等自動化工具。高性能技術架構實踐根據顧問規劃，開發符合用戶需求的最佳實踐 AI 自動化工作流，並在實作中確保系統的 效能 (Performance)、安全性 (Security) 與 穩定性 達到企業級標準。技術問題攻堅直接處理 AI 落地時的硬核挑戰，如：Prompt 工程優化、長文本處理策略、多模型效能評估及數據隔離架構等疑難雜症。高品質技術方案交付負責完整的技術交付流程，包含系統架構文檔撰寫、代碼移交與環境部署，確保解決方案能在客戶端長期穩定運行。技術方案迭代與優化從跨產業的實戰案例中提煉技術通用性，優化 Aiworks 的實施工具與方法論，提升企業規模化 AI 導入的效率。
【Why join us?】
深厚的產業實績：參與服務 200+ 家企業的經驗累積，您將接觸不同產業的 AI 落地場景。OpenAI 合作夥伴視野：作為 OpenAI Service Partner，您將掌握最前沿的模型應用技術與官方資源。定義未來工作方式：您的工作成果將直接改變企業更多職涯人士的日常，實踐真正的人 AI 協作轉型。顧問與技術的雙軌成長：在這裡，您不僅能精進 AI 技術，更能磨練成為一名具備商業思維的高階 AI 轉型顧問。

data.title: AI演算法工程師/AI Algorithm Engineer(竹南/台北)
data.description:
負責分析AI算法在實際系統架構運行時的效能瓶頸。
AI 應用成為近幾年的主流，軟體服務的效能依賴於幾個重點：系統架構設計、演算法的實作、硬體規格。
過去為了提升協作開發效率，計算機領域主要朝著抽象化的方式，降低各層互相的耦合性。
然而，這其中的權衡奠基在過去硬體隨著摩爾定律效能快速的成長，在大型系統中往往能藉由過剩的硬體效能彌補抽象化造成的損失。 然而，AI 時代迎來模型參數和運算需求指數成長的情況，這是少數已經具有商業價值需求的算法，超出現有硬體算力需求的狀況。 所以，以整體作為優化的研究，成為當前相當具有價值的工作。縱向的打破各層之間的抽象，找出不同實作之間能獲得最佳效能的搭配。
1. 基於演算法(多為平行運算)估算運算複雜度和空間使用量
2. 基於硬體配置，估算演算法在系統上的理論表現
3. 設計 DOE 實驗，驗證實際數據與理論數據的誤差
4. 基於實驗結果，找出演算法、軟體實作、系統、硬體的瓶頸
5. 實作優化算法，藉由實驗結果和理論分析證明其有效性
6. 撰寫技術文件，提供應用服務端作為實作參考。The responsibility involves analyzing performance bottlenecks of AI algorithms during operation within actual system architectures.
AI applications have become mainstream over recent years. The performance of software services relies on several key factors: system architecture design, algorithm implementation, and hardware specifications.
In the past, to improve collaborative development efficiency, the computing field primarily focused on abstraction to reduce coupling between different layers.
However, this trade-off was based on the rapid growth in hardware performance driven by Moore’s Law. In large systems, excess hardware capabilities often compensated for losses caused by abstraction. However, the AI era brings exponential growth in model parameters and computational demands. This situation occurs with only a few algorithms that already possess commercial value requirements, exceeding existing hardware computing capabilities. Therefore, research focusing on overall optimization has become highly valuable work. Breaking down vertical abstractions between layers to identify optimal combinations among different implementations becomes essential.
Estimating computational complexity and space usage based on algorithms (mostly parallel computing)Estimating theoretical performance of algorithms on systems based on hardware configurationsDesigning DOE experiments to verify discrepancies between actual and theoretical dataIdentifying bottlenecks in algorithms, software implementation, systems, and hardware based on experimental resultsImplementing optimized algorithms, demonstrating their effectiveness through experimental results and theoretical analysisWriting technical documentation to provide application service providers with implementation references.

隨著工業自動化、物聯網（IIoT）與智慧電網的蓬勃發展，各場域（如電廠、油田、資料中心）對穩定且高可靠度的工業通訊協定需求日益劇增。工業協定（Industrial Protocol）在工業界發展近45年，至今仍不斷湧現新一代的國際標準。Moxa作為全球領先的工業網通品牌廠商，緊跟技術潮流，致力於研發最前沿的工業協定模組。

Enterprise Applications 團隊為整個集團的技術心臟，負責處理全球跨國據點間高併發、大流量的異質系統資料鏈結。我們重視技術影響力與實務解決能力，團隊氛圍開放、鼓勵創新與 AI 工具深度運用，為資深架構專家提供能充分發揮技術主導權的廣闊舞台。  
【工作內容】
架構設計與 Deliverable Review：主導整合團隊的系統架構設計，審查團隊產出，確保設計品質、一致性與最佳實踐。  系統重構與效能優化：深入分析現有系統架構與 Legacy Code，能在「規格文件不全」的狀況下推導邏輯，進行核心系統重構與穩定度提升。  DevOps 與工作流編排：運用 Apache Airflow 進行排程與 Task Orchestration，並管理獨立伺服器與正式環境服務之穩定度。  跨團隊技術諮詢：與 SA（系統分析師）密切合作，提供即時、可行性高的技術解決方案建議。  AI 導入與技術領導：推動 AI 工具於團隊開發與營運流程的落地，協助團隊成員升級技術技能與 Code 質量。  
【使用的技術】
Core Languages: Java, Python  Orchestration  Integration: Apache Airflow, 國際物流標竿系統 (CargoWise / CW1) 模組與 eAdapter  Cloud  Infrastructure: AWS, Standalone Server Management, DevOps Practices  Workflow  Collaboration: Git, Jira, Confluence, AI Coding Assistants

data.title: Server Platform Systems HW Lead
data.description:
Server Principal Systems Lead Engineer

At Dell Technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation, driving the future of AI enterprise systems for our customers. Our Infrastructure Solutions Group Compute Systems Engineering (ISG CSE) organization is dedicated to creating cutting-edge solutions that empower businesses worldwide. We believe in fostering a collaborative and dynamic environment of innovation where your ideas can thrive while also making a profound social impact.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Principal Systems Lead Engineer on our System Development Engineering Team in Taipei, Taiwan.

 
Take the first step towards your dream career
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

Essential Requirements
Development Engineering Expertise: Strong background in development engineering of compute, storage, and networking architectures, with proven experience in designing solution-level AI enterprise data center systems.
Leadership and Team Management: Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to manage and inspire multi-disciplined engineering workgroups to achieve outstanding results. Strong ability to influence others to drive project success.
Communication and Collaboration: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams and external partners.
Quality Assurance and Problem Solving: Expertise in root cause analysis, defect resolution, and test plan architecture to ensure high-quality standards.
Strategic Business Acumen: Strong business acumen to drive strategic initiatives and optimize project outcomes. Educational requirements include 12 to 15 years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree or 8+ years with a master’s degree.

 
What you’ll achieve

We are seeking a passionate and visionary Systems Lead Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be at the helm of solution-level engineering for AI enterprise system hardware across compute, storage, and networking. You will lead and inspire a multi-disciplined engineering team and partner with other leaders within Dell’s cross-functional organization, driving excellence and innovation in every aspect of your project, managing high-complexity AI products through the entire lifecycle. Join us to do the best work of your career.

You will:
Architectural Leadership and Collaboration: Engage with internal Dell team members, vendors, and technical partners across global sites to drive architectural excellence in product design. Build and maintain strong relationships to ensure alignment and success.
Development and Integration Management: Oversee and coordinate development efforts across diverse engineering teams, ensuring seamless collaboration and delivery. Work across subsystems including hardware design for high-speed signal circuit boards, CPU & memory complexes, GPUs and accelerators, network devices and fabrics, enterprise storage arrays, direct liquid cooling solutions, AC-DC and DC-DC power architectures, Dell iDRAC systems management software, BIOS, FPGA, firmware, enterprise operating systems, and data center rack-solution designs.
Quality Assurance and Issue Resolution: Identify and resolve issues efficiently, ensuring the highest quality standards. Design and implement robust test plans to validate system performance and reliability.
Strategic Business and Portfolio Management: Apply strong business insights to drive strategic decisions and optimize project outcomes to meet our customers’ needs. Drive solution and release readiness with a closed-loop focus on best practices across portfolios and business units.
Vendor and Technical Partner Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors and technical partners to ensure alignment and success. Engage in root cause analysis and defect resolution to maintain high-quality standards.

Experience working directly with hardware

Drive cross-team collaboration to resolve escalations and critical/blocking issues

data.title: Senior Systems Development Engineer
data.description:
Senior Systems Development Engineer
 
Our customers operate highly complex, mission‑critical environments that demand deep technical expertise across hardware, software, and full‑system architecture.
As part of the Customer Engineering team, you will work at the intersection of system design, advanced diagnostics, and performance engineering.
This includes analyzing integrated electronic and electro‑mechanical systems, conducting feasibility and architecture evaluations, and developing specifications that ensure robust, predictable system behavior.
The Customer Engineering Team focuses on advanced root‑cause analysis, performance optimization, configuration tuning, and long‑term stability improvements.
You will tackle the toughest technical challenges in enterprise environments—driving solutions that improve reliability, scalability, and overall system efficiency for global customers.
Join us as a Senior Systems Development Engineer on our Customer Engineering Team in Taipei, Taiwan.
 
What You’ll Achieve
As a Senior Systems Development Engineer, you will:
Collaborate with core engineering teams, Customer Support, Incident Management, and customers to stabilize and optimize enterprise environments.
Perform root cause analysis and kernel-level debugging on supported enterprise operating systems running on Dell hardware.
Apply your expertise in computer architecture and OS internals to resolve complex issues and improve system resilience.
Drive impact beyond technical problem-solving by shaping strategic initiatives that improve efficiency, resilience, and operational excellence.

 
Key Responsibilities
Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware/software issues using advanced tools and methodologies.
Conduct detailed RCA and provide actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders.
Build strong relationships with cross-functional teams to drive collaborative problem-solving.
Design and implement intelligent automation solutions, leveraging AI and emerging agentic technologies to enhance productivity and operational efficiency.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership across the organization.

 
Requirements
Work Model: Onsite, 5 days a week (remote/hybrid not eligible).
Schedule: Weekend work on a rotational basis (comp days provided), occasional early/late shifts, and overtime as needed.
Experience: 8+ years in software/hardware engineering (or equivalent) with deep expertise in one or more of the following:Object storage
NAS (Network Attached Storage)
Linux/BSD operating systems
Networking and protocol stacks (SMB, NFS, etc.)
Filesystems
Analytics, observability, and data science

Technical Skills:Proficiency in Java, C, Python, and scripting
Proven experience in developing automation frameworks and applying AI/agentic tools to drive operational efficiency and scalability

 
Who We Are
We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do.
If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.
Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play.
Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.
Dell Technologies is committed to equal employment opportunity and fostering a workplace free of discrimination and harassment.

Our customers operate highly complex, mission‑critical environments that demand deep technical expertise across hardware, software, and full‑system architecture.

  As part of the Customer Engineering team, you will work at the intersection of system design, advanced diagnostics, and performance engineering.

  This includes analyzing integrated electronic and electro‑mechanical systems, conducting feasibility and architecture evaluations, and developing specifications that ensure robust, predictable system behavior.

The Customer Engineering Team focuses on advanced root‑cause analysis, performance optimization, configuration tuning, and long‑term stability improvements.

  You will tackle the toughest technical challenges in enterprise environments—driving solutions that improve reliability, scalability, and overall system efficiency for global customers.

Join us as a Senior Systems Development Engineer on our Customer Engineering Team in Taipei, Taiwan.

What You’ll Achieve

As a Systems Development Engineer 2, you will:

 Collaborate with core engineering teams, Customer Support, Incident Management, and customers to stabilize and optimize enterprise environments.

 Perform root cause analysis and kernel-level debugging on supported enterprise operating systems running on Dell hardware.

 Apply your expertise in computer architecture and OS internals to resolve complex issues and improve system resilience.

 Drive impact beyond technical problem-solving by shaping strategic initiatives that improve efficiency, resilience, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

 Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware/software issues using advanced tools and methodologies.

 Conduct detailed RCA and provide actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders.

 Build strong relationships with cross-functional teams to drive collaborative problem-solving.

 Design and implement intelligent automation solutions, leveraging AI and emerging agentic technologies to enhance productivity and operational efficiency.

 Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership across the organization.

Requirements

 Work Model: Onsite, 5 days a week (remote/hybrid not eligible).

 Schedule: Weekend work on a rotational basis (comp days provided), occasional early/late shifts, and overtime as needed.

data.description: LumiTure 是 CloudMile 推出的 FinOps 平台，負責整合雲端帳務與用量資料，將其跨平台正規化後，轉換為成本洞察、預測與優化建議提供給客戶。後端是整個平台的引擎： Data pipeline、API 與各種整合，都仰賴後端確保資料正確無誤、服務快速回應。        我們正在尋找一位資深後端工程師，能獨立且完整地交付後端功能：從需求、 資料模型，到 API、測試與正式環境上線。這是一個資深個人貢獻者（IC）職位。你不需要管理團隊，但你會在艱難的技術問題上深入鑽研，把經過充分研究的提案：包括架構選項、 資料建模與擴展取捨，提供成熟方案交付給主管進行決策。日常中，你透過持續交付程式碼與審查，持續拉高產品程式碼品質與產品韌性。隨著平台的用戶帳務與用量資料量持續成長，這個職位將有部分職責包括 Data Engineering：我們希望找到的人，在打造可靠、可擴展的 Data pipeline 時能一樣得心應手。【工作內容】◎ 獨立交付後端功能，從概念到上線：從規格、資料模型，到 API、測試與正式環境上線，基於我們的 Python／Django 技術棧；能把商業需求一路推進到產品上線。◎ 負責資料密集型服務：帳務／用量匯入 Data pipeline、彙總與報表，以及對應的 API； 兼顧資料一致性、完整性與效能，並隨著資料量成長維持可靠性與成本效益。◎ 研究並提出架構選項：資料建模、服務邊界、快取，以及面對大量資料的擴展策略，附上清楚的取捨分析，與技術主管討論定案後推動執行。◎ 維持正式環境的健康：分析並調校 PostgreSQL 查詢、透過日誌與監控診斷問題， 並負責修復。◎ 拉高工程標準：透過程式碼同儕審查、有意義的自動化單元與整合測試、清楚的 SDD 規格文件， 以身作則帶動品質。◎ 跨領域協作：與前端、產品、設計等跨職能合作順暢，交付完整且範圍明確的版本。【職務需求】◎ 5 年以上後端工程實務經驗。◎ 紮實的 Python 能力，並具備 Django 與 Django REST Framework 的正式環境 深度經驗（或具備能快速對應到我們技術棧的同等框架經驗）。◎ 紮實的關聯式資料庫能力：偏好 PostgreSQL，包含 schema 設計、查詢優化、 索引，以及在運行中系統上的 migration。◎ 具備設計與維運 RESTful API 的經驗，且實際被前端或第三方客戶端使用。◎ 能針對正確性與規模進行推理：並行處理、交易一致性， 以及在正式環境中診斷細微的資料正確性問題。◎ 將自動化測試（如 pytest）與文件視為交付的日常一環。◎ 與 AI agent 協作的能力（DevAIOps）：能把 AI coding agent 與 agentic workflow 融入日常開發，從規格、實作到測試都能有效運用 AI 工具放大產出。這是我們團隊運作的核心一環，也是我們持續投資的方向。◎ 強烈的當責意識：能把模糊的問題一路推進到產品上線，並在意正確性、可維護性。【核心職能】◎ 能把模糊的需求，在少量協助下一路交付到正式環境。◎ 提案經過深入研究，有具體選項、取捨與佐證資料，讓技術主管能快速做出決策。◎ 程式碼經少數幾輪審查即可合併；測試能在上線前攔下回歸問題。◎ 對自己負責範圍內的正式環境問題當責：能快速診斷並修復。【加分條件】◎ 具備 GCP、AWS 或 Azure 等雲端平台實務經驗。◎ 資料工程能力：具備針對大量且持續成長的資料設計 ETL/ELT 與批次處理 的實務經驗，並能為分析與報表進行資料建模。你在意吞吐量、資料品質與成本， 而不只是「工作有沒有跑完」。◎ 具備資料倉儲與現代資料工具經驗：如 BigQuery、dbt、Airflow／Cloud Composer、Dataflow/Spark 或 Pub/Sub，用於處理大規模的分析型資料。◎ 具備 FinOps、雲端成本管理、帳務系統，或大規模財務／分析資料的背景。◎ 具備可觀測性工具經驗（如 Sentry、Cloud Logging）與正式環境事故處理經驗。◎ 能適應規格驅動開發的工程協作流程。

data.title: 全端工程師 Full Stack Engineer
data.description: 【職務說明】我們正在尋找一位充滿熱情的 Full Stack Engineer,能夠橫跨前端與後端、從產品功能開發到雲端基礎架構皆能參與。你將與產品、設計與資料團隊緊密合作,在混合雲平台上打造高可用、可擴展的服務,並將想法快速落地為使用者真正會用到的產品。我們重視的不只是寫出能動的程式,更在意系統設計的品質、可維護性,以及能與團隊共同成長的態度。如果你喜歡端到端地擁有一個功能(從資料庫設計、API 到使用者介面),這個角色會很適合你。【工作內容】◎ 參與產品功能從規劃、設計、開發、測試到上線的完整生命週期。◎ 使用 Python 開發後端服務與 API,確保程式碼具備良好的可讀性、測試覆蓋率與效能。◎ 使用 React 開發響應式、可重用的前端介面,並與設計師協作優化使用者體驗。◎ 設計與維護資料庫結構,撰寫並優化 SQL 查詢,確保資料一致性與查詢效能。◎ 運用 BigQuery 進行大規模資料儲存、分析與查詢優化,支援資料導向的產品決策。◎ 在 GCP 上部署與維運服務,熟悉以 Cloud Run 部署容器化應用,並使用 GKE(Google Kubernetes Engine)管理需要更高彈性與規模的工作負載。◎ 設定與調校負載平衡(Load Balancing),確保服務在高流量下仍能穩定分流、維持可用性與低延遲。◎ 設計與實作使用者身分驗證與授權(Authentication / Authorization)機制,確保 API 與資料存取的安全性。◎ 使用 Firebase / Firestore 處理即時資料同步、使用者驗證與輕量後端需求。◎ 撰寫技術文件、參與程式碼審查(Code Review),並持續改善團隊的開發流程與工程品質。◎ 監控線上系統、排查問題並進行效能調校,確保服務穩定運行。【職務需求】◎ 程式語言與框架 - 熟悉 Python,具備後端服務或 API 開發經驗。 - 熟悉 React,能獨立開發前端介面並理解元件化、狀態管理等概念。◎ 雲端與基礎架構(GCP) - 具備雲端環境應用系統開發實務經驗。 - 熟悉 Cloud Run,能將應用容器化並部署為無伺服器服務。 - 具備 GKE(Google Kubernetes Engine)使用經驗,理解容器編排與基本 Kubernetes 概念。 - 具備負載平衡(Load Balancing)設定經驗,理解流量分流、健康檢查與擴展機制。◎ 安全與身分驗證 - 具備身分驗證與授權(Authentication / Authorization)實作經驗,熟悉如 OAuth 2.0、JWT、SSO 或 IAM 等機制其中一種以上。 - 理解 API 安全性與存取控制的基本原則。◎ 資料庫與資料處理 - 熟悉 SQL,能設計資料表結構並撰寫、優化查詢。 - 具備 BigQuery 使用經驗,能進行大規模資料查詢與分析。 - 熟悉 Firebase / Firestore,理解 NoSQL 資料模型與即時資料庫的應用場景。【我們期待的特質】 - 良好的問題分析與解決能力,能在資訊不完整時做出合理判斷。 - 重視程式碼品質與系統可維護性,願意持續學習新技術。 - 具備良好的溝通與協作能力,能與跨職能團隊(產品、設計、資料)有效合作。 - 對產品有 ownership,願意端到端地負責一個功能的成敗。 - 能在快速變動的環境中保持彈性,並樂於分享知識、互相成長。【加分條件】（非必要但優先考慮）◎ 熟悉 Cloudflare(如 CDN、DNS、WAF、DDoS 防護或 Cloudflare Workers 等),具備邊緣網路或網路安全防護經驗。◎ 有 CI/CD 流程建置經驗(如 Cloud Build、GitHub Actions 等)。◎ 熟悉 Infrastructure as Code(如 Terraform)。◎ 具備微服務架構或分散式系統設計經驗。◎ 熟悉三大雲端平台(GCP/AWS/Azure)

data.title: 【新竹 | 擴大徵才】資深前端工程師 Senior Frontend Engineer
data.description:
汪喵星球成立於2015年，於2020年茁壯為百人團隊，我們仍努力保有新創團隊獨有的扁平溝通與團隊合作模式。隨著汪喵星球的茁壯，越來越多的用戶帶來更多的技術挑戰，從高承載量的服務平台、可乘載高併發流量的雲端架構、快速的Feature迭代、大量數據的分析，許多技術的挑戰等著你來征服！為了提供更好的購物體驗，歡迎喜歡挑戰、與追求技術成長的夥伴加入！★若你還在猶豫汪喵星球，可以先看看我們的工程師文化 :

【從數據掌握真實問題，精進技術成長】
汪喵飛速成長的使用量和團隊，所帶來的技術挑戰與新功能拓展的需求，不論是喜歡設計架構或是程式設計的你，都可以找到有興趣的問題來解決。在問題的定義上，我們透過分析和對於數據的掌握，確保夥伴們的努力，都能有對應創造的價值，努力不會白費！
【難題不是一個人的事，團隊主動互相幫助】
遇到問題的時候，團隊會一起解決，不會讓一個夥伴自己卡在難關上；問題解決後，也會將問題分析並且文件化，讓挑戰成為下一次的養分。
【在這裡人生就是不斷的進步，好還要更好】
團隊每個人都有能夠表達意見的機會，定期回顧一起走過的路，並思考未來怎麼做得更好。團隊定期也會安排內部的讀書會與課程的分享，在進步的路上可以互相幫忙。公司另有內訓與外訓的經費，讓技術的職涯持續成長。
【你需要負責的工作內容】1. 負責電商／平台系統的前端功能開發與維護，與 PM、設計、後端協作，將需求落地並持續迭代2. 規劃並推動前端架構、元件化與工程化，提升整體開發效率與品質3. 建立與維護共用元件，確保跨頁面與跨專案一致性4. 處理複雜互動流程，打造良好產品體驗5. 推動可觀測性：整合錯誤回報與使用者操作軌跡／事件追蹤，協助快速定位與改善問題6. 透過 code review、技術分享，協助團隊共同提升能力與交付品質【我們希望你有的經驗跟特質】1. 精通 React/Vue 等主流框架，熟悉 JavaScript/TypeScript，能處理複雜互動與狀態管理，對架構、模組化、工程化有深入理解；具 Next.js / SSR / RSC 或類似框架經驗優先2. 具備產品思維與商業理解，能理解電商/平台系統的核心價值，並轉換成可落地的技術方案3. 具備良好溝通與 Ownership，能主動推進協作與問題拆解；對寵物產業有熱情並願意與團隊快速成長4. 注重使用者體驗，具備效能與體驗優化經驗5. 加分項：樂於分享/mentor、善用 AI 提升產出、有管理或技術帶領經驗

data.title: IT Platform Engineer
data.description:
Established in 1987 and headquartered in Taiwan, TSMC pioneered the pure-play foundry business model with an exclusive focus on manufacturing its customers’ products. As of 2024, TSMC serves more than 500 customers and manufactures over 11,000 products for high-performance computing, smartphones, the Internet of Things (IoT), automotive, and digital consumer electronics. It is the world’s largest provider of logic ICs, with an annual capacity of 16 million 12-inch equivalent wafers. TSMC operates fabs in Taiwan as well as manufacturing subsidiaries in Washington State, Japan and China, and the Company began construction on a specialty technology fab in Dresden, Germany, in 2024. In Arizona, TSMC is building three fabs, with the first starting 4nm production in 2025, the second by 2028, and the third by the end of the decade.
As a platform engineer, you will focus on designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable features and services on the platform to support the productionization of applications that support the company’s RD/Fab/Business/IT/Security functions to improve the productivity and work quality.
Responsibilities:
Automation and Scripting1. Develop and maintain automation scripts for configuration, monitoring, and management using tools such as Ansible and Python.2. Transform repeatable tasks into automation tools to streamline operations and maximize efficiency.3. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate resource provisioning and CI/CD workflows.Application Development1. Develop scalable cloud-native microservice architectures for IT applications.2. Develop state-of-the-art applications and refactor existing ones to improve performance and maintainability.3. Apply software design principles, such as 12-factor app, to ensure sustainability and quality.4. Write and implement tests (unit/feature/integration) to guarantee software integrity.Monitoring and Troubleshooting1. Implement monitoring solutions to proactively identify and resolve network and application issues.2. Conduct root cause analyses and apply corrective actions to troubleshoot technical challenges, including Linux-related systems and logs (e.g., Go code/log analysis).3. Lead evaluation and adoption of new IT technologies for continuous improvement.(Optional) Network Design and Management1. Operate and manage network infrastructure, including LAN, WLAN, Firewall, and Proxy.2. Design, implement, and manage scalable network architecture aligned with business goals and industry best practices.

data.description: Software Systems Engineering is an arm of systems engineering that addresses the development of complex software-intensive systems. It involves analyzing, designing, developing, testing, and maintaining a broad range of software based on specific user needs, while taking into consideration the quality, time, and budget required.  The individual needs to understand and be able to explain all features of the system software.  The SSE needs to work with the product owner, developers, and QAs on understanding how the system should work and how the software supports its functionality. •	A Software Systems Engineer will assess a problem and design a new system or improve the existing one to make it better and more efficient. The SSE should understand software interfaces, support and control of third-party devices.•	Other duties may be assigned as required.

data.description:

Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
The camera software team is looking for talented software engineers experienced in the development of software for mobile, IOT and devices. The camera software team is responsible for delivering camera drivers, HAL, and hetero-processor processing features for Snapdragon chipsets, providing best-in-class performance, power, and image quality.
This role involves working at all layers of the camera software stack, from Android Camera HAL implementation to low-level hardware control. The role includes exposure to camera technologies such as 3A, ISP, and camera sensors, as well as integration with motion sensors, video encoders, DSPs, GPU, and display.

Design and develop new camera software features
Support new hardware and platforms
Debug issues within the software
Optimize software for performance and power
Develop unit tests
Work with partners and OEMs

Qualifications
4+ years of experience in software development for mobile or platforms
Strong programming skills in C and C++
Strong operating system understanding
Experience with object-oriented programming
Multi-threaded programming experience
Self-motivated and strong continuous learning desire is a must

Preferred Qualifications
History of development of Android HAL components is big plus
Strong C/C++ skills is big plus
6+ years of experience with APIs
6+ years of experience working in a large matrixed organization
Good team work and collaboration is a big plus
Linux kernel or user-space development experience or V4L2 experience
Experience working with real-time systems (Linux or Android)
Experience in the development of drivers and frameworks for multimedia systems, including camera, audio, video, AR/VR, CV, display, or graphics

Self-driven engineering leadership with the ability to take initiative and work with minimal guidance

Good teamwork and effective cross-team communication

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Applications Engineering
General Summary:
Job Description

As a forward-thinking technology company, Qualcomm advances the limits of innovation in Industrial and Embedded IoT to deliver next-generation experiences and accelerate digital transformation toward a smarter, more seamlessly connected world.
We are seeking a Senior Product Application Manager who will be the core driver behind the technical definition and market adoption of our next-generation Video SoC products. In this strategic role, you will act as a technical authority, translating deep insights from customers and the ecosystem into concrete product software specifications and system architecture.
This position is strongly software-oriented and functions closer to a Software Product Application Manager. The role requires deep understanding of embedded firmware and Linux-based system architecture, the ability to evaluate system-level trade-offs, and the capability to drive software strategy alignment across multiple Camera / Video SoC platforms.
 
Responsibilities
Analyze customer system requirements, product architectures, and technical roadmaps, and translate them into SoC software and system-level solutions.
Act as the software-focused product application owner for the Video SoC software stack, including boot flow, BSP, SDK, and middleware.
Evaluate and validate firmware and system architecture proposals using embedded domain knowledge and AI-assisted research, assessing feasibility, risks, and long-term maintainability.
Coordinate with other Camera / Video SoC software PDMs to align software strategies, including:
  Linux version selection and kernel maintenance approach
  Partial SDK interface and architecture alignment across platforms
Drive cross-SoC software consistency where appropriate, and clearly define boundaries where divergence is required due to architecture, performance, or market needs.
Consolidate product and competitor benchmarking data to generate analytical reports and drive performance enhancement and differentiation initiatives.
Travel Frequency: Approximately 4 times per year (Destinations: US, India, or China).
 

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
At least 5 years of relevant experience, with 8+ years strongly preferred.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with strong cross-functional collaboration capability.
Solid background in embedded firmware or system software, with hands-on experience or equivalent technical depth in embedded Linux-based systems.
Proven ability to independently judge firmware constraints, implementation risks, and system-level trade-offs, without reliance solely on development teams.
Ability to leverage AI tools and technical references to cross-validate firmware designs, Linux subsystem behavior, and architectural assumptions.

Preferred Qualifications 
Prior collaboration with multiple Camera / Video SoC platforms, especially in aligning or comparing Linux kernel strategies and SDK designs.
Experience supporting customer SoC products in a technical, application, or solution-facing role.
Familiarity with multimedia pipelines, ISP, camera sensors, and video frameworks.

Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.  
                                                                    OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field. 

•    1+ year of any combination of academic and/or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
•    1+ year of any combination of academic and/or work experience with debugging techniques.

設計與開發 Wren AI 與 Wren AI Service參與核心語意查詢引擎開發，透過 LLM 打造 生成式 AI 應用 (Gen AI app)，提升 AI 在數據查詢與分析上的精確度與實用性與數據團隊和前端團隊合作，將 Wren AI 整合到實際應用場景中，驅動更強大的 AI 解決方案。開源專案維護與推廣積極參與並推廣 Wren AI 開源專案，處理社群反饋與技術問題，與全球開發者社群保持互動。協助開源社群解決使用上的問題，並將關鍵反饋回饋給內部研發團隊，推動產品迭代與優化。跨部門合作與 Data Team 與 Web Team 緊密合作，參與從數據查詢引擎到前端應用的全流程開發與部署，確保 AI 服務的穩定性與可擴展性。技術探索與創新保持對 LLM 技術的高度敏感度，積極探索最新的 AI 技術趨勢 (如 RAG 模型或大型語言模型微調)，並思考如何將其應用於實際業務場景，設計更智能、更好用的 AI 功能。

data.title: Android Kernel Quality Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
The Quality Infrastructure Engineer is a crucial operational role responsible for the continuous health, stability, and performance of the automated testing environments supporting Android Kernel quality efforts. You will ensure maximum availability of the testing fleet, maintain the integrity of the CI/CD pipeline, and serve as the first responder for automated test failures. This position demands a strong focus on automation, data integrity, and strict adherence to Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
Key Responsibilities
1. Infrastructure and Fleet Reliability
•	Maximum Uptime: Maintain a minimum 99.9% uptime for both physical and virtual Android device fleets essential for Android Kernel quality testing.
•	Automation Health: Configure and monitor all pre-submit, post-submit, and release testing pipelines, ensuring lab automation efforts operate at a sustained 99% uptime.
•	Test Maintenance: Proactively identify and fix existing Android kernel test failures and develop new test configurations or minor test code patches as requested.
2. First-Tier Triage and Resolution
•	SLO-Driven Response: Perform first-tier triage for all issues resulting from automated test routines, strictly adhering to the following SLOs:
o	Pre-submit Failures: Resolution/Triage within 2 business days.
o	Post-submit Failures: Resolution/Triage within 5 business days.
•	Issue Management: Document and track issues, providing "issue breadcrumbs" to facilitate faster root cause analysis by downstream engineering teams.
3. Reporting, Data, and Metrics
•	Dashboard Development: Design and develop automated report dashboards to visualize critical metrics, focusing on lab uptime, fleet health, and key issue patterns.
•	Data Integrity: Process all test result data meticulously according to established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
•	Stakeholder Reporting: Prepare and deliver weekly status updates, and formally report processed test result data and insights directly to the Android Kernel Quality Lead.
Qualifications
•	3+ years of technical experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure QA roles, specifically supporting CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
•	Proven ability to configure, monitor, and troubleshoot test automation systems.
•	Strong commitment to maintaining and exceeding high operational uptime standards (e.g., 99.9%).
•	Experience with data processing and developing technical dashboards or automated reports.
•	Demonstrated ability to conduct first-tier triage and rapidly analyze test failure logs in a kernel or system software context.

data.title: Android Kernel Test Operations Engineer (Systems & Greenness)
data.description:
We are hiring a dedicated Kernel Test Operations Engineer to take full ownership of the operational health and stability (often referred to as "Greenness") of all kernel test versions managed by the Android Systems team. This critical engineering role ensures continuous, high-fidelity testing of Android Common Kernels by maintaining robust test infrastructure, rapidly diagnosing failures, and driving core test metrics towards zero failures.
This role requires a proactive approach, deep debugging skills, and strict adherence to service level agreements (SLOs).
Key Responsibilities
1. Test Infrastructure Maintenance  Health
•	Sustain Operations: Maintain the internal pre-submit, post-submit, and related test infrastructure for all Android Common Kernels to ensure optimal functionality and availability.
•	Continuous Coverage: Enforce continuous testing across Android kernel trees. Guarantee that no branches or targets remain untested for more than 2 business days.
•	Test Integrity: Monitor pre-submit and post-submit test suites to prevent unintended test auto-disabling. Ensure all enabled Test Suites (TS) are constantly running.
•	Technical Patching: Resolve test infrastructure issues, including writing minor test code or configuration patches (using C++, Python, Java, and Bash) to fix unreliable tests and restore test harness stability.
2. Breakage Analysis and Resolution
•	Dashboard Ownership: Review and monitor all established kernel build and boot test dashboards. Immediately investigate and "drill down when red."
•	Rapid Triage: Lead the bisection, isolation, and triage of test breakages. Revert the culpable commit if necessary to quickly restore the harness to a "green state."
•	Escalation: Partner with EngProd and other teams on complex infrastructure issues, escalating to the Technical Lead (TL) only when deep root cause analysis or urgency demands it.
•	SLO Adherence (Patching): Submit urgent/critical test configuration updates or minor test code patches assigned by the TL within 1 business day. Complete all other assigned patches within 3 business days.
3. Quality Fine-Tuning and Goal Setting
•	Drive Greenness: Actively work to ensure the list of test failures is stable and trending down, targeting an ideal state of zero failures.
•	Test Optimization: Fine-tune the pre-submit CTS and VTS test configurations. This includes enabling new tests to achieve better kernel coverage and disabling tests with duplicate coverage.
•	Issue Tracking: Ensure all identified bugs and issues have their status updated on a daily basis.

data.description:

Job Area:

General Summary:
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Machine Learning Engineer, you will create and implement machine learning techniques, frameworks, and tools that enable the efficient discovery and utilization of state-of-the-art machine learning solutions over a broad set of technology verticals or designs. Qualcomm Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance the world of mobile, edge, auto, and IOT products through machine learning hardware and software.
We are looking for a Senior or Staff level Engineer to work on bleeding-edge AI technology. You will architect high-performance software for AI engines, including Qualcomm AI Engine Direct (QNN), and define the strategy for deploying Large Language Models (LLM) and Vision-Language Models (VLM) on strictly power-constrained hardware. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams (HW/SW architecture) to enhance the world of mobile, edge, and IoT products. This is a great opportunity to innovate and develop leading-edge products around best-in-class Qualcomm AIoT devices.

Responsibilities
Architectural Leadership: Lead the development of AI SW stack framework enhancements for optimal resource usage while running complex Transformer-based networks (LLM, ViT) on Qualcomm hardware.

Research to Production: Lead efforts in transitioning research (e.g., new quantization techniques, efficient CLIP encoders) into production-ready solutions, enabling real-world applications and commercial impact.’

GenAI Optimization: Drive the development of optimization algorithms for ML operators/layers specific to Generative AI (e.g., KV-cache optimization, attention acceleration) within the Qualcomm AI SW stack.

Performance Tuning: Evaluate and optimize neural networks’ runtime performance (latency, memory, power) and accuracy using tools like AIMET and QNN SDK.

Software Development: Develop software tools for profiling and debugging to support the rapid deployment of new neural networks.

Feature Enablement: Work with customer teams to enable state-of-the-art network models and new AI SW features to meet customer use-cases, and collaborate with AI hardware teams to continuously improve our AI solution.

Minimum Qualifications
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a PhD with 2+ years of experience.

Proficient in modern C, C++, and Python.

Deep experience in neural network deployment, quantization, and model compression (specifically for Transformers/LLMs).

Solid understanding of neural network inference frameworks for embedded systems (e.g., QNN, TFLite, NCNN, ONNX).

Preferred Qualifications
8+ years of experience in embedded Linux development or AI/ML application engineering.

Experience in video/image processing, computer vision, or multimedia algorithm development (relevant for CLIP/Vision tasks).

Hands-on experience with LLM/VLM model pipelines, including fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization on NPU/DSP.

Experience with Qualcomm AI Stack specifically "AI Engine Direct SDK (QNN)" and "AI Model Efficiency Toolkit (AIMET)".

Familiarity with hardware accelerators (Hexagon DSP) and embedded architectures.

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

data.description: 職位摘要： 我們正在尋找一位具備 3 年以上實務經驗的「全端軟體工程師」，加入我們的開發團隊。您將主要使用 .NET 技術，獨立或與資深工程師協作，設計、開發並維護高效率、可擴展的 Web 應用程式。此職位要求您對大型關聯式資料庫 (Oracle/MS SQL) 有深入理解與優化經驗，並能獨立負責前端介面的開發與整合。我們期待您能主動解決複雜的技術挑戰，並積極貢獻於程式碼品質與團隊成長。主要職責：1. 獨立負責或與資深工程師協作，主導或參與軟體開發生命週期 (SDLC) 中的需求分析、系統設計、開發、測試與部署環節。2. 使用 C# 程式語言及 .NET Framework / .NET Core 平台，設計、開發與維護高效率、可擴展的後端服務及應用程式。3. 深入參與大型關聯式資料庫 (Oracle 或 MS SQL Server) 的設計、開發、性能調優與維護，包括資料表規劃、索引策略、儲存程序、函數及複雜 SQL 查詢的優化與故障排除。4. 獨立開發與整合使用者介面，運用 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 和 Bootstrap 等技術，確保良好的使用者體驗和響應式設計。5. 獨立撰寫並執行單元測試 (Unit Test)、整合測試 (Integration Test)，並協助進行系統測試，確保程式碼品質與系統穩定性。6. 積極參與程式碼審查，提供專業見解與建設性意見，並協助指導初級工程師。7. 主動分析、診斷並解決複雜的技術問題，進行系統性能優化與維護。8. 持續關注業界新技術與趨勢，並評估其應用潛力，為團隊引入新的解決方案。

data.title: 【研發部】 後端工程師
data.description:
我們正在尋找熟悉 PHP / Laravel 的研發工程師，加入數字科技研發部，一起優化既有產品系統、改善內部開發流程，並透過 AI 工具與新技術提升工程效率。
這個職位不只是維護系統，也會參與功能設計、效能優化、架構改善與研發專案落地。適合喜歡解問題、重視程式品質，也願意用新工具提升開發效率的工程師。

研發部任務：參與產品後端功能開發、維護與版本迭代使用 PHP / Laravel 開發與優化既有系統與產品、設計、前端、PM 協作，評估需求可行性並提出技術方案優化系統效能、資料庫查詢與服務穩定性維護與改善內部系統架構、開發流程與技術文件使用 AI 工具輔助開發、測試、除錯與文件整理參與研發專案，驗證新技術或新方案是否能實際落地

研發部在幹嘛：https://gamma.app/docs/-km76anm6whz1jjb獎勵機制：年終績效分紅獎金，每年有調薪機會。
我們在用的 Tech Stack：Backend：PHP、LaravelFrontend：VueDatabase：MariaDB / MySQL、Redis、BigQueryInfrastructure：Linux、Nginx、Docker、KubernetesCloud：AWS、GCPVersion Control：GitAI Tools：Claude Code、ChatGPT
我們期待你的加入，如果你具備：2 年以上程式開發經驗，熟悉 PHP理解 MVC 架構，具 Laravel 開發經驗熟悉 SQL 基礎語法，能處理資料查詢與效能問題具備 Linux 基本操作能力熟悉 Git 版本控制了解 Docker 基本概念或實務使用經驗願意使用 AI 工具提升開發效率，並能判斷 AI 產出的正確性具備清楚溝通、主動解決問題與團隊協作能力
加分條件：
資工、電機、資管或相關科系背景熟悉 JavaScript、Python 或其他後端語言有系統效能優化、架構調整或大型網站維護經驗有雲端服務 AWS / GCP 使用經驗參與過技術社群、技術分享或開源專案對新技術有好奇心，看到重複性問題會想用程式改善流程
你在這裡可以成長的方向初期，你會熟悉既有產品架構，參與功能開發、系統維護與技術文件整理。中期，你會開始針對產品或系統問題提出解法，參與效能優化、架構調整與跨部門專案。長期，你可以主導技術方案落地，協助團隊導入新工具、新流程，並成為能帶動工程品質與研發效率的核心成員。


加入研發部，我們這樣寵你
＊實質回饋，伴隨你的成長
共享成果： 除了勞健保與團保，提供生日、三節禮金、年終績效分紅獎金，期待產品成長能分享給你更多。薪資成長： 只要有持續性的良好表現，一年至少調薪一次，讓你的努力被看見。持續進修： 每年提供 10,000 元 課程書藉、學習進修補助，支持你不斷進化、提升自我。＊盡情充電，去看更大的世界環遊世界： 定期國內、外員工旅遊（歐洲、美國、澳洲、日本）並提供旅遊補助，下一站我們一起決定！優於法規的假期： 年資滿三個月即享 7 天特休；週休二日、颱風假、女性生理假、產假及男員工陪產假皆為基本必備。所有的補班日皆不需上班，讓你擁有更完整的休息時間。＊能量補給，照顧你的胃與心美食不間斷： 舒適的工作環境提供免費零食、飲料、每月水果日及節慶下午茶；隨時補充你的戰鬥力。午餐小確幸： 公司提供團膳午餐補助，每餐僅需 30 元，為你省下不少膳食開銷。人生大事都在場： 結婚補助、生育補助通通有，你的人生成長我們也想參與。＊活力生活，工作玩樂都要兼顧健康至上： 提供定期年度免費員工健康檢查，關心你的強大心臟。熱血社團： 籃球、羽球、有氧課...各式運動社團均有補助，並定期舉辦大型運動會比賽。公司文化： 扁平化制度溝通簡單直效。每季舉辦慶生會聚餐，不定期玩桌遊、密室脫逃，工作之餘也要一起瘋！

我們提供豐富的資源與指導，幫助你在成長路上不斷進步。如果你準備好迎接挑戰加入我們的研發團隊，歡迎來聊聊！

data.title: Data Center System Application Engineer
data.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Communication Technologies Ltd.
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Applications Engineering
General Summary:
Join a high-impact Customer Engineering(CE) team enabling next-generation server processor platforms for one of the world’s leading semiconductor innovators. As a Customer Engineer, you will serve as a technical interface between strategic customers—including hyperscalers, OEMs, and ODMs—and internal product teams, helping to launch and sustain industry-leading server SoCs.
This role is ideal for a seasoned technical expert and communicator who thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. You will drive customer adoption from concept to commercialization and mass production, representing the voice of the customer internally while delivering best-in-class technical support externally.

You will be one of the founding members of a to-be-hired server CE team and will help shape the team’s future structure and priorities. In this role, you will lead firmware customization and address challenging issues and work closely with both internal teams (software, hardware, validation, security) and external collaborators (such as OEMs and ODMs), often leading pivotal firmware projects.

Key Responsibilities:
Customize firmware to support unique hardware configurations, board-specific features, and custom boot flows for ARM servers
Collaborate with hardware teams for board bring-up and validating new platforms
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software, target and test teams, to ensure complete understanding of the solution and maturity
Collaborate closely with internal engineering, software, validation, and product teams to address technical challenges and customer feedback
Identify gaps in customer and internal design expectations and propose practical solutions or mitigations
Partner closely with OEMs/ODMs, review and verify BIOS code from OEMs/ODMs
Support manufacturing and platform validation processes
Support power management and performance tuning
Deliver high-quality technical documentation, training, and onboarding material for customer enablement
Drive continuous improvement of support processes and infrastructure to scale across customer engagements

Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
5+ years of experience in applications engineering, customer-facing technical roles with strong experience in Firmware development / customization
Proficiency in C programming and assembly (x86 or ARM).
Familiarity with BMC/IPMI, and remote management protocols.
Experience with hyperscaler firmware requirements.
Experience with open-source contributions for example in EDK II, Coreboot etc would be valuable. 
Hands-on experience with the UEFI specification and its modular architecture.
Development and debugging of UEFI drivers and applications.
Understanding of UEFI Secure Boot, capsule updates, and runtime services.
Familiarity with ARM Architecture and ARM server extensions.
Knowledge of memory management, exception levels, and privilege modes.
Experience with ARM Trusted Firmware and secure boot mechanisms.
Experience with device initialization, peripheral drivers, and board bring-up.
Knowledge of hardware interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, USB, etc.).
Ability to analyze crash logs, memory dumps, and trace data to isolate issues.
Deep proficiency in Linux kernels, DDR, PCIe, and communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, and MDIO
Strong technical documentation skills and excellent written and verbal communication

Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
10+ years of experience in applications engineering, customer-facing technical roles
Understanding of operating system boot loaders, kernel initialization, and handoff processes.
Experience with Linux, especially in ARM server environments.
Knowledge of ACPI, SMBIOS, and other system description tables.
Familiarity with secure boot, cryptographic libraries, and Trusted Platform Module (TPM).

Experience mitigating security vulnerabilities (CVE) in firmware.  

Understanding of threat modeling and secure coding practices.
Demonstrated ability to influence internal teams and manage customer engagements with high autonomy
Strong troubleshooting skills for complex system-level issues.
Ability to analyze and interpret technical documentation and specifications.
Resourcefulness in researching new ARM/UEFI developments and solutions.
Experience with multi-socket and virtualization firmware hooks would be highly recommended.

Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.  
                                                                    OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.
                                                                    OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.

•    2+ years of experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
•    1+ year of experience with debugging techniques.

data.title: Customer Engineering – Embedded Software Boot and Stability Engineer
data.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Communication Technologies Ltd.
Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Applications Engineering
General Summary:
This position is within Qualcomm’s Customer Engineering (CE) organization and focuses on system stability, issue triage, and customer escalation support across embedded platforms. The role works closely with customers, internal development teams, and cross‑functional stakeholders to identify, debug, and resolve complex system-level software issues on Qualcomm SoCs from early bring‑up through commercialization.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on stability engineer with deep knowledge of Windows and/or Linux kernel, device drivers, BSP, and SoC architecture, strong debugging skills, and a customer‑first mindset. This role plays a critical part in improving platform stability, meeting product quality metrics, and enabling customer success.

Key Responsibilities
Act as a primary technical escalation and triage point for customer‑reported system and stability issues
Debug complex system‑level issues across boot, kernel, drivers, power, memory, and interconnects
Perform root cause analysis using logs, dumps, tracing, and hardware debug tools (e.g., WinDbg, JTAG)
Collaborate closely with customer engineering, platform, FW, and HW teams to drive issues to resolution
Analyze issues related to:OS crashes, hangs, watchdog resets
Memory leaks, heap/stack corruption, resource exhaustion
Power management, suspend/resume, performance regressions
Driver integration and BSP mismatches

Reproduce customer issues in lab environments and validate fixes
Track issues across lifecycle and drive closure with ownership and clear communication
Provide technical status updates to customers and internal management
Contribute to stability improvements, debug guidelines, and best practices
Support customer on‑site or remote debug activities when required

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of relevant experience
OR
Master’s degree and 4+ years of relevant experience

Required Technical Skills
Strong experience with embedded systems and system‑level debugging
Solid understanding of OS internals (Windows and/or Linux kernel)
Hands‑on experience with:Windows kernel‑mode drivers (KMDF) and/or Linux device drivers
BSP components: boot flow, ACPI, UEFI, device tree

Proficiency in C/C++, with debugging‑centric development experience
Experience using debug tools:WinDbg, crash dump analysis
JTAG / hardware debug tools (Trace32 is a plus)

Strong knowledge of ARM architectures (ARMv8/ARM64)
Excellent problem‑solving, analytical, and root‑cause analysis skills
Strong communication skills and customer‑focused attitude

Preferred Qualifications
Proven ability to integrate AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex) with appropriate model selection (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) into daily development and debugging workflows.
Demonstrated track record of developing custom skills, MCP integrations, and automation scripts that significantly reduce team Time-to-Triage (TTT).
Experience supporting IHVs / OEMs / ODMs in a customer engineering role
Exposure to both Windows and Linux on embedded platforms
Experience debugging:Power management (sleep states, rail voting, resume failures)
Multi‑core and multi‑processor systems

Familiarity with embedded firmware interactions (PMIC, bootloaders, FW services)
Experience coordinating cross‑team debugging efforts under tight schedules
Ability to mentor junior engineers on stability and debug practices

Minimum Qualifications:
•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.  
                                                                    OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.
                                                                    OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field. 

•    1+ year of any combination of academic and/or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
•    1+ year of any combination of academic and/or work experience with debugging techniques.

Applicants: Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e-mail disability-accomodations@qualcomm.com or call Qualcomm's toll-free number found here. Upon request, Qualcomm will provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities to be able participate in the hiring process. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. (Keep in mind that this email address is used to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries).

Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law.

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Qualcomm. Staffing and recruiting agencies and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Qualcomm does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Qualcomm employees or any other company location. 晧飛思（Heph A.I Studios）是一家專注於 AIGC（AI 生成內容） 的創新公司，

我們的 iOS 應用正引領 AI 互動的新世代，

工作內容
協助開發與優化 數字人、語音互動、AI 內容生成 相關的 iOS 應用程式

成長與挑戰
在晧飛思，你將在實戰中快速成長，從「執行者」逐步成為「創造者」。
你將有機會：

與 設計師、資深工程師 一起打造新世代 AI 應用
參與產品與團隊 從 0 到 1 的建構過程，理解一個 AI 應用如何誕生

在實務中累積產品開發與架構經驗，建立屬於自己的技術方向
我們重視實作與學習潛力，而非僅僅履歷。
若你熱愛開發、樂於探索新技術，我們會提供足夠的引導與支持，陪你一起成長。

這裡的挑戰，來自未知與創新；

data.description:
The Role — Engineer
This is not a "take tickets, ship UI" role. We are looking for an engineer who can carry the PM × Engineer archetype on our Senior AE track:

Judge what to build, not just how. Look across the card pool, decide which features unlock revenue fastest, ship them, then own retention.
Talk to clients directly. Team scouts, TV producers, league operators — you'll work with them 0–1 layer away to scope and de-risk requirements.
Prototype-driven. Claude Code is our core productivity tool. We expect you to use AI assistants natively to compress build → ship cycles.
Own end-to-end delivery. Frontend, backend, schema, deploy — you should be comfortable shipping a feature alone if needed.
Key Responsibilities

Develop, deploy, test, and maintain user-facing surfaces for our cloud platform — covering video editing, live streaming tools, and sports game management software.
Work directly with clients and operations to translate ambiguous requirements into shippable specs; set your own priorities in coordination with the CTO and COO.
Build and optimize systems that handle live video streams, real-time metadata, and AI-driven post-processing.
Use TypeScript and React/Redux on the frontend, Node.js and Python on the backend, Postgres + PostgREST for data, plus tools like GitHub, Docker, and AI APIs (Gemini, Claude).
Integrate third-party APIs and tools to support live streaming, real-time game statistics, and AI editing capabilities (Gemini, OBS, RTMP/HLS pipelines).
Write runbooks and harden recurring incidents — reduce the load on the on-call rotation by fixing root causes.

Golang 團隊主要負責交易撮合以及區塊鏈錢包等功能，除了業務邏輯的開發維護，我們也會跟 SRE 合作導入新技術以及優化架構，例如為了提升系統可觀測性，埋入更多 promethues metrics 以及導入 opentelemtry。


身為 Golang 團隊的一員，你會感受到我們的團隊文化是：

比起單打獨鬥，我們更重視主動的溝通，在每日站立時，大家會清楚地說明負責的工作項目內容，目的是讓團隊能清楚彼此的工作範圍，提升整體對系統的熟悉度，也能互相提醒注意事項。
比起定義 Deadline，我們更重視定義明確的 Delivery，Sprint 開始前，大家會明確定義這次 Sprint 的產出，在 Sprint 的結束會彼此分享並 Demo 產出的內容，目的是每次 Sprint 聚焦工作目標，讓工作成果能有節奏地累積。
比起 Top-Down 指配任務，我們更重視雙向的討論，我們會定義每季的 OKR，目的是讓組員能清楚知道每個專案對公司的價值，也給組員機會向上提供專案建議，建立個人目標與公司目標的關聯。
比起沈默不語，我們更重視有火花的溝通，鼓勵大家表達想法，擁抱不同的意見，雖然溝通有時會耗費心力與時間，但溝通能幫助我們凝聚共識，瞭解彼此，提升合作默契，在我們團隊中，溝通的準則是先對齊情境與問題，在討論方法與實作。
比起馬上寫扣，我們更重視先做好系統分析，每個專案開始前都會透過系統分系，定義清楚專案的實作內容以及修改範圍，避免專案做到一半，發現要重構或方向錯誤，也避免專案做完發現沒兼顧可擴充的特性。
比起這樣就好，我們更重視深度地討論，我們明白專案會有時程的壓力，我們不追求實作能立馬完美，但期望在系統分析的過程中，能有深度地討論，能清楚明白當前設計的風險以及取捨。
比起一成不變，我們更重視調整與進步，我們是扁平的團隊，有任何想法都會被提出並討論，除了專案之外我們也會討論工作合作方式，例如 Code Review 機制，PR 顆粒度，如何回收技術債等等，沒有人是完美的，我們期待互相激勵，促進反思進步。
比起工作關係，我們更重視夥伴關係，除了工作專案交流，我們平常也會交流生活，每月聚餐，講幹話，討論職涯，討論如何發財，討論新技術等等。



工作內容

身為團隊的 Senior 工程師，我們期待你：

能成為專案的負責人，主動與 PM 釐清模糊的需求，主持系統分析會議，切分專案的實作內容，協助成員理解專案，分配任務，擔任專案主要窗口，與其他團隊說明 API 串接方式，規劃專案 Release 以及壓測計畫等。
能主動發掘系統中待優化的地方，並在團隊會議主動提出並主持討論，協助其他成員理解問題脈絡，一起討論優化方案，主動規劃落地方案。
在不同專案的系統分析中，不僅能在業務邏輯中給予設計上的想法，也能在架構層提供精準的建議，例如 index 的設計，query 的使用，redis 結構設計如何降低記憶體使用率等。
能幫助團隊在文化上，開發流程以及 best practice 不斷地迭代改進。
對團隊與專案擁有責任感，面對問題能主動釐清，協助他人找到解法，面對複雜的問題，要有找不到 Root Cause 不善罷甘休的氣勢。
要有能力清楚且有脈絡地表達與論述事情。
對於溝通富有耐心，可以堅持立場，但不會輕易爆氣，期望你能指導其他工程師，能主動分享技術知識。
提供高品質的程式，例如清楚的命名，好維護的封裝，可測試的程式，清楚易用的介面，內聚高的業務模組。
與不同團隊與部門能緊密的合作，例如與 PM 合作專案，與前端合作 API 串接，與 QA 合作自動化測試的建置，與 SRE 合作導入新的架構與工具。


進入後


1個月內，你將會：

了解團隊開發流程
了解團隊開發 Convention
建制開發環境
透過新手專案，熟悉 codebase 以及開發流程
修復一個技術債
了解不同專案的 Scope 以及參與系統分析

3個月後，你將會：

解決更複雜的架構性技術債
負責交易所交易核心以及 API 優化與維護
主導或參與更多專案
參與團隊 OKR

data.title: Software Development Engineer, Ring
data.description:
With affordable solutions that work on any home, Ring is committed to offering smart security that's accessible to everyone. Now Ring is seeking experienced software engineers who will help us create the next generation of home security. What will you help us create?

You'll develop software for next-generation embedded systems that protect millions of homes worldwide. Beyond leveraging AI agents and Generative AI tools, you'll also contribute to developing and deploying AI agents that are revolutionizing software development workflows. Backed by Amazon's world-class AI resources and infrastructure, you'll have the support to continuously explore emerging AI technologies, enhance your skills, and drive innovation in product development. Work at the forefront of the AI-driven development revolution, shaping methodologies that will define the future of software engineering. This is your opportunity to lead tomorrow's development practices today.

Key job responsibilities
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will be a core member of the Ring Taiwan development team. You'll collaborate with world-class engineers and industry experts across multiple countries, gaining exposure to diverse perspectives, and global-scale product development. This is a unique opportunity to grow your career within a multi-national technology leader while working alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.
The ideal candidate would be passionate about building IoT products and eager to pioneer AI-powered tools that revolutionize embedded software development. You must be responsive, flexible, and able to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment.

The ideal candidate:
Is enthusiastic about developing and adopting AI/ML technologies and tools to enhance software development practices
Enjoys working side by side with partners, colleagues and teams across different countries and time zones
Is highly effective and thrives in a dynamic environment with multiple, changing priorities
Knows what is important when shipping products to customers and has been through the process from start to finish
Is comfortable with proactive outward communication and technical leadership and never shies away from a challenge

Work hard. Have fun. Make history.
BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Enthusiasm for adopting and developing AI/ML technologies and tools to enhance software development practices
5+ years of software development experience
Extensive experience in computer architecture and embedded wireless systems
Extensive embedded development experience in C/C++, and familiarity with ARM CPUs
Extensive experience with writing low-level drivers, interrupt service routines and general troubleshooting/debugging with hardware
Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field
Experience with AI-powered development tools (e.g., Amazon Kiro, Amazon Q Developer, or similar AI coding assistants)
Hands-on experience developing AI agents, automation scripts, or AI-assisted workflows to improve development efficiency
Knowledge of Python or scripting languages commonly used with AI tools and automation
Demonstrated passion for exploring and adopting emerging technologies to drive innovation and code quality
Experience with one or more commercial wireless protocols like BLE or Wi-Fi
Experience in software development and testing of battery powered products
Experience with development tools like GCC and Git version control system
Experience with common bus protocols such as SPI, I2C, and UART
Experience with software testing (unit, regression and system testing)
Knowledge of embedded Linux and FreeRTOS
Prior experience with system bring-up, manufacturing line testing, or wireless networking drivers
